human_policy: Development first; previous strict/network/capacity failures remain deferred and unaccepted.
current_implementation: OptionalMonsterPool is false in current configuration. Real kills automatically append a monster card to discard. Existing optional offers/accept/skip/replacement remain isolated candidates.
source_findings: Earlier monster pool tests use repeated card IDs or manually issued offers; they do not prove legal default decks and actual current kill provenance.
The current server projection sends monster_pool only for a room with its frozen optional policy enabled; client entry depends on this original projection.
Previous dilution measurements used a controlled native shuffle and lacked retained per-seed originals. They are not full encounter or route benefit evidence.
legal_deck: C01-C13 plus class 01-07; twenty distinct enabled codex cards at level zero, owned inventory and DeckRules validation required
T01: Current config policy, legal actual room kills, no optional choice action or payload in current Protobuf snapshot; disabled decision rejects without mutation.
T02: Independent monster-species-to-card mapping for each original actual kill; actor/battle/monster/new instance identity, base instance preservation, pool conservation and discard entry. BOX element override retained.
T03: Original legal base and actual automatically expanded deck enter native discard/recycle. Retain each seed's key and second same-element draw ordinal, original per-card printed damage and pool sizes separately; no claim that more printed power proves encounter benefit.
controlled_kill_scope: Declared OFFLINE boundary setup reduces original generated monsters to one remaining HP; the finishing PlayCards uses current owned visible hand. This is not a natural full encounter, expedition route or LIVE kill claim.

dilution_control.mechanism: Native CombatDeck recycle/shuffle, one draw then discard; analysis can inspect the original pool, player decisions cannot inspect future library order
dilution_control.outcome: Descriptive key/same-core arrival and printed-power separation only

native_execution: Tencent cloud only; bounded job while B08.4 experiment continues when resource reservations fit
source_storage: Reuse dependency cache read-only; avoid duplicate cloud package copies. Raw results verified on G before cleanup.
